title: A Declined work order's Bill To can still be changed
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, that bills itself.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in Declined, that bills itself.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Expand the Customer card.
  3. Click the Bill To field.
  4. Pick customer B in the list.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer A, with status Declined.

Step 2:

  • The Customer card shows a "Bill To" field under Authorizer, reading "This customer".

Step 3:

  • The list opens.

Step 4:

  • The Customer card's "Bill To" field reads customer B's name.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12305 (Story 3, Bill To on the work order and part sale Customer card)

  • Terminology: “Open / Invoiced → Open means Estimate, Approved, In Progress, Ready for Review, Complete or Declined. Invoiced means Invoiced or Paid.”
  • Feature Overview, State by action (Action | Open | Invoiced | Internal or No Charge): “Pick or change the Bill To | Allowed. Refused while deposits are held (M1). | Read-only (M4) | No Bill To”
